propositions: Current clarity measure duplicates logic across two files and rewards volume/legacy shape rather than author-guide compliance, allowing padded plans to pass without grounded Scope or per-criterion verification

Required-section shape should be keyed on graph altitude (leaf vs. container) with deterministic parsing rules: all plans require nonempty Context/Problem and AC; leaves require Approach and Scope; containers require AC plus child decomposition

AC verification coverage must parse checkbox items and require each to either start `[operator-attested]` or contain explicit proving clauses (verify/check/verified by) with command, test, or artifact assertion

Scope and Approach sections must be placeholder-free, detected by case-insensitive exact matches of guide lexicon (TBD, figure out, depends on investigation, etc.) with fenced/quoted examples excluded
Per-AC text hygiene should flag bundled outcomes, subjective language, and unproved hedges (should, probably, seems) at the AC-item level without whole-plan vague-word scanning
Author guide currently conflicts with authoritative criteria on Success Criteria collapse and rejected-alternative requirements, requiring bug 828a-7407-9d68-4b82 resolution before clarity encoding
